deliverables: Instant on-chain distribution to the intended recipient upon governance action enactment
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to reimburse the lost deposit for the Ikigai Info governance action, plus compensation for lost staking rewards.

claims.claim: The Ikigai Info governance action was submitted in September 2024 only weeks after the Chang hard fork introduced on-chain governance.
The Ikigai Info governance action was symbolic and asked the community whether they agreed with a statement thanking contributors and expressing hope for Cardano's future.
A Cardano node bug permitted an unregistered stake key to be used in the governance action, preventing the submitter from recovering a 100,000 ADA deposit.
The community expressed at the time that the Ikigai Info governance action deposit should be reimbursed via a treasury withdrawal.
Entity-based budget submissions did not include reimbursement after the Plomin hard fork made treasury withdrawal reimbursement possible.
The Cardano in Oceania initiative included the deposit reimbursement in its budget Info governance action, but that governance action was not approved.
The withdrawal requests 103,000 ADA, consisting of the original 100,000 ADA deposit plus 3,000 ADA for staking rewards calculated at 2% per annum.
The recipient has not previously received funds from the treasury.
The requested amount does not exceed the current Net Change Limit.
The proposal references an AdaStat governance page for the original governance action.

summary: The document requests 103,000 ADA to reimburse a claimed unrecoverable 100,000 ADA governance deposit and 3,000 ADA in lost staking rewards, with most key factual assertions stated by the proposer and only the referenced governance action externally checkable from the document.
